svg.title: Control the Placement Before Buying the Lease
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-placement-to-collection; chart type: process_flow; title: Control the Placement Before Buying the Lease; subtitle: Five linked records connect payer authority to collected housing cash.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Operating framework for authorized ALE and corporate placements lasting approximately 30–270 days. A referral is neither payment authorization nor a signed occupancy agreement.; caption: The control point is a documented match among landlord permission, payer commitment, occupant terms, and lease exposure.; stages: label: Qualify the placement; value: Capture payer, dates, household, and authorized budget; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record the contracting payer, claim or purchase-order reference, household requirements, covered dates, and spending limit in Airtable. Obtain written authority before representing a carrier as the debtor.; label: Secure lawful inventory; value: Obtain explicit landlord corporate-housing sublease permission; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Execute a property-specific written addendum covering corporate occupants, subletting, furnished use, access, maximum occupancy, and lease-break terms; reject verbal permission and conflicting building restrictions.; label: Price the exposure; value: Match approved stay economics against committed lease costs; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Quote rent, included utilities, utility caps, taxes, deposits, and extension pricing separately. Stress-test an early claim closeout against remaining landlord rent and the next realistically obtainable placement.; label: Deliver and extend; value: Document readiness, access, and written extension authority; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Capture condition photographs and a readiness checklist; issue time-limited smart-lock access. Use authorized ALE or CRS portal exports to reconcile dates, and request extensions before current funding expires.; label: Collect and reconcile; value: Match invoices, receipts, deposits, and landlord settlements; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile approved nights and documented utility-cap charges in QuickBooks Online. Keep refundable deposits separate from earnings; close access credentials and record vacancy exposure when occupants depart.

rect.title: label: Qualify the placement; value: Capture payer, dates, household, and authorized budget; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record the contracting payer, claim or purchase-order reference, household requirements, covered dates, and spending limit in Airtable. Obtain written authority before representing a carrier as the debtor.

text.title: Record the contracting payer, claim or purchase-order reference, household requirements, covered dates, and spending limit in Airtable. Obtain written authority before representing a carrier as the debtor.

rect.title: label: Secure lawful inventory; value: Obtain explicit landlord corporate-housing sublease permission; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Execute a property-specific written addendum covering corporate occupants, subletting, furnished use, access, maximum occupancy, and lease-break terms; reject verbal permission and conflicting building restrictions.

text.title: Execute a property-specific written addendum covering corporate occupants, subletting, furnished use, access, maximum occupancy, and lease-break terms; reject verbal permission and conflicting building restrictions.

rect.title: label: Price the exposure; value: Match approved stay economics against committed lease costs; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Quote rent, included utilities, utility caps, taxes, deposits, and extension pricing separately. Stress-test an early claim closeout against remaining landlord rent and the next realistically obtainable placement.

text.title: Quote rent, included utilities, utility caps, taxes, deposits, and extension pricing separately. Stress-test an early claim closeout against remaining landlord rent and the next realistically obtainable placement.

rect.title: label: Deliver and extend; value: Document readiness, access, and written extension authority; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Capture condition photographs and a readiness checklist; issue time-limited smart-lock access. Use authorized ALE or CRS portal exports to reconcile dates, and request extensions before current funding expires.

text.title: Capture condition photographs and a readiness checklist; issue time-limited smart-lock access. Use authorized ALE or CRS portal exports to reconcile dates, and request extensions before current funding expires.

rect.title: label: Collect and reconcile; value: Match invoices, receipts, deposits, and landlord settlements; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile approved nights and documented utility-cap charges in QuickBooks Online. Keep refundable deposits separate from earnings; close access credentials and record vacancy exposure when occupants depart.

text.title: Reconcile approved nights and documented utility-cap charges in QuickBooks Online. Keep refundable deposits separate from earnings; close access credentials and record vacancy exposure when occupants depart.
Assumptions: Operating framework for authorized ALE and corporate placements lasting approximately 30–270 days. A referral is neither payment authorization nor a signed occupancy agreement.
